about: 蓝白 · 第 7a 幕（F2h → F5）布局：唯一的数据源。Act07_Sea/Tools~/act07_layout.py 生成；搭建脚本 蓝白/Build/Act07a 读它建网格、填驱动；参考帧 Act07_Sea/Docs~/lookdev/scene_7a.py 也读它。圣经 v2.1 §6·7a，总导演裁决 D-09 / D-17 / D-21 / D-23。

frames.world: Unity, bus fixed at the origin, heading +z
frames.water: x right, y up from the sea surface (= -depth), z = bus heading
frames.eye_note: main seat eye = Gate cameras.U7 = render harness hero; LB_Journey.heroEye is (0.70, 1.77, 0.20)

window.note: the act-7 driver owns F2h - 1 .. exit + 1; this package fills 7a (to F5) and holds the 7a end state after F5 until 7b / 7c arrive

sink.law: v(t) = v0 + sum dv * smoothstep((t - t0) / dur); x(t) = exact integral from T0 (x(T0) = 0); smoothstep integral: x^3 - x^4 / 2 on [0, 1], then 0.5 + (x - 1)

forward.law: v(t) = v0 + sum dv * smoothstep((t - t0) / dur); x(t) = exact integral from T0 (x(T0) = 0); smoothstep integral: x^3 - x^4 / 2 on [0, 1], then 0.5 + (x - 1)

handover.note: F2h: the Clouds driver switches its sea off, this one switches the plane on (same y, ABOVE material M_06_Sea); at eye_under_t (the waterline covers the eye) the plane takes M_07a_SeaSurface, _Udon_Underwater 0 -> 1 (README_Sea接口 §5)

sea.object: Sea_Disc.fbx under R_Sea at water y 0
sea.window_gain_note: F3e1: 窗在 8 秒里从藍白缩暗成一枚暗币 (smoothstep), x the material _WindowGain (18)
sea.window_core_vr_law: VR: lerp(desktop, vr, smoothstep(0, 1, erosion(t) / 0.25)) with erosion(t) = the cabin fade 0 -> 0.25 linear F2h -> F5 (bible §4.8 table); the roof still there = the desktop numbers (D-23 #2)

water.law: by the bus ORIGIN depth: linear between keys (density, up, mid, down); _Udon_Fog = (density, 0, 0, 1), RenderSettings.fogDensity = density, _Udon_FogBase = 0, _Udon_WaterFog{Up,Mid,Down} = (rgb, 1)

caustics.note: x = strength (cabin floor depth = bus origin depth), z = t

sun.render_mode: Important (the one shadowless pixel light that carries the cookie)
sun.culling: Default + PlayerLocal (F4p: the light lands on your hands)

ambient_trilight.note: RenderSettings Trilight (bible §6·7a 补光); written by the owner of RenderSettings (给总控 第五批)

cabin.note: the timeline / cabin driver writes these (bible §4.8 table), listed so the reference frames use the same numbers

gather.note: F4p: the shafts converge on the skylight hole in 9 s; the gather point is the skylight (bus frame); the driver writes _GatherPoint in R_Sea object space each frame

last_shaft.note: F3e1: the last wide shaft sweeps across the seats (2 s in, 4 s sweep, 2 s out; seats <= luma 120), then all shafts are gone

material.note: low contrast: the faces sit just above the water fog of 105 m; only the silhouettes catch the hull bioluminescence #8AC6FF (bible: 只被船体生物荧光描出一道边), full strength out to rim_near_m, falling off over rim_reach_m beyond; wrap: the trails run along the whole hull

grade.note: S7a until F3e, then S7a -> S7b linear F3e -> F5 (LB_Journey.ApplyGrades owns the PPv2 weights; this driver reports no dEV)
